segments.caption: A group of parkour practitioners in Charlotte perform dynamic movements across an urban campus environment, with one athlete executing a handstand atop a large, tiled monument while others train on surrounding brick structures.

A young man performs an acrobatic sequence outdoors, beginning with a handstand atop a large, tiled monument. He then executes a dynamic flip, launching himself over a low brick wall, before landing and crouching on the other side, showcasing his agility and control in an urban setting.

A man in a green shirt performs push-ups on a low brick wall in an outdoor campus setting, with a large building and trees in the background. The sequence captures his focused effort, showing his upper body, hands gripping the wall, and a close-up of his legs as he lowers himself.

A group of people are gathered outdoors on a grassy field for a game or activity, with one person in a green shirt crouching in a ready stance while others watch. The scene shifts to show participants moving and gesturing, indicating active engagement in a dynamic, possibly competitive, outdoor event.

The segment opens with them preparing and posing, with one man gesturing towards the camera. They then strike a group pose, huddled together with arms around each other, before dispersing to stand and sit in a line, showcasing camaraderie and youthful energy against the backdrop of the campus architecture. The segment concludes with a title card for the “Charlotte Video Project.”
